description: CLOSE AN INCREMENT THAT WILL NOT BE FINISHED, honestly, on the owner's word: `deferred` (still meant, later), `dropped` (no longer meant; `reason` says why) or `superseded` (by the increment `superseded_by` names). Only an open increment closes. NO UNFINISHED ITEM IS DEFAULTED: `leftovers` answers for every item scheduled for it and not delivered, each `moves` (to another open increment, `to`: a recorded slip), is `dropped` from it (with its `reason`; the item itself keeps its status, so dropping it here retires no intent), or, on a deferral only, `stays`. One missing, doubled or unknown answer refuses the whole call, naming every problem, and nothing is written. When an item leaves and the plan is not on the record yet, `recorded_in` names an epoch that has HAPPENED to file the plan's snapshot in, so arrival_delta reads each item as moved or dropped rather than the plan as always smaller. Writes one ChangeEvent with every fate and reason, linked to what moved. `approver` is REQUIRED: the close is the owner's word. A deferred increment leaves the open-increments list and is counted apart; set_epoch_status reopens it. Ask for this to defer, drop or supersede an increment that is not going to be finished.

fate.description:
`moves` (to another open increment, named in `to`: a recorded slip),
`dropped` (from this increment only, with `reason`; the item keeps its
own status) or `stays` (with a DEFERRED increment only).

item_id.description:
The item scheduled for the increment and not delivered (a Requirement,
Capability, Question, Verification or Decision id).

reason.description: With `dropped`: why, in the owner's words. Required there.

to.description: With `moves`: the open (`planned`) DesignEpoch it moves to.

acted_at.description:
When the owner gave their word, as a plain date: stored on the approver
edge, dates the close's ChangeEvent, and dates a moved item's new
schedule.

approver.description:
The Contributor whose word closes it — the OWNER'S SIGNATURE. Draws
`AUTHORED_BY role=approver` on the increment. REQUIRED; an id naming no
Contributor is refused before anything is written.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

how.description:
`deferred` (still meant, later), `dropped` (no longer meant; `reason`
required) or `superseded` (by `superseded_by`).

leftovers.description:
ONE ANSWER FOR EVERY UNFINISHED ITEM scheduled for it — none is
defaulted. Leave out what is delivered. An empty list closes an
increment with nothing unfinished.

reason.description:
Why it closes, in the owner's words. REQUIRED for `dropped`; stored as
the epoch's `close_reason` and in the close's ChangeEvent.

recorded_in.description:
An ARRIVED epoch to file the plan's snapshot in (and pin the close's
ChangeEvent to), needed when an item moves or is dropped and the plan
is not on the record yet.

superseded_by.description: With `superseded`: the DesignEpoch that took its place.

name: close_increment
title: Close an Increment
